| base report descs ids objects objectIds encode exportPredicate exportAccessor exportNode decode decodePredicate decodeAccessor exportGraph reports |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
reports := OrderedCollection new.
#('/private/tmp/magritte-cpp-editing-native.json' '/private/tmp/magritte-swift-editing-native.json') do: [ :path | | input nodes graph exported model |
descs := Dictionary new. ids := IdentityDictionary new. objects := Dictionary new. objectIds := IdentityDictionary new.
input := NeoJSONReader fromString: path asFileReference contents.
self assert: (input at: 'format') = 'magritte.graph/3'.
nodes := input at: 'descriptions'.
nodes do: [ :n | | d | d := (Smalltalk globals at: (n at: 'class') asSymbol) new. descs at: (n at: 'id') put: d. ids at: d put: (n at: 'id') ].
(input at: 'objects') do: [ :o | | m | m := MAAdaptiveModel description: (descs at: (o at: 'description')). objects at: (o at: 'id') put: m. objectIds at: m put: (o at: 'id') ].
decode := [ :v | | type items | type := v at: 'type'.
 type = 'nil' ifTrue: [ nil ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'reference' ifTrue: [ objects at: (v at: 'value') ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'boolean' ifTrue: [ v at: 'value' ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'integer' ifTrue: [ (v at: 'value') asInteger ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'float' ifTrue: [ Float fromIEEE64Bit: (Integer readFrom: (v at: 'value') base: 16) ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'symbol' ifTrue: [ (v at: 'value') asSymbol ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'string' ifTrue: [ v at: 'value' ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'character' ifTrue: [ (v at: 'value') first ] ifFalse: [
 items := (v at: 'value') collect: [ :e | decode value: e ].
 type = 'array' ifTrue: [ items asArray ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'ordered' ifTrue: [ items asOrderedCollection ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'set' ifTrue: [ items asSet ] ifFalse: [
 type = 'bag' ifTrue: [ items asBag ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unknown value' ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
decodePredicate := [ :p | | cls result | cls := p at: 'class'.
 cls = 'MAPluggableCondition' ifTrue: [ MACondition receiver: (decode value: (p at: 'receiver')) selector: (p at: 'selector') asSymbol arguments: ((p at: 'arguments') collect: [ :v | decode value: v ]) asArray index: (p at: 'index') ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MANegationCondition' ifTrue: [ (decodePredicate value: (p at: 'conditions') first) not ] ifFalse: [
 self assert: cls = 'MAConjunctiveCondition'. result := MAConjunctiveCondition new. (p at: 'conditions') do: [ :child | result & (decodePredicate value: child) ]. result ] ] ].
decodeAccessor := [ :a | | cls | cls := a at: 'class'.
 cls = 'MAChainAccessor' ifTrue: [ MAChainAccessor accessors: ((a at: 'steps') collect: [ :step | decodeAccessor value: step ]) ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MASelectorAccessor' ifTrue: [ MASelectorAccessor read: (a at: 'readSelector') asSymbol write: ((a at: 'writeSelector') ifEmpty: [ nil ] ifNotEmpty: [ :s | s asSymbol ]) ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MAVariableAccessor' ifTrue: [ MAVariableAccessor name: (a at: 'name') ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MANullAccessor' ifTrue: [ MANullAccessor uuid: (decode value: (a at: 'uuid')) ] ifFalse: [
 cls = 'MAIdentityAccessor' ifTrue: [ MAIdentityAccessor new ] ifFalse: [
 self assert: (#('MADictionaryAccessor' 'MAPropertyAccessor') includes: cls).
 (Smalltalk globals at: cls asSymbol) key: (cls = 'MAPropertyAccessor' ifTrue: [ (a at: 'key') asSymbol ] ifFalse: [ a at: 'key' ]) ] ] ] ] ] ].
nodes do: [ :n | | d |
 d := descs at: (n at: 'id').
 (n at: 'properties') keysAndValuesDo: [ :key :v | key = 'separators' ifTrue: [ d separators: (decode value: v) ] ifFalse: [ d propertyAt: key asSymbol put: (decode value: v) ] ].
 d isContainer ifTrue: [ (n at: 'children') do: [ :id | d add: (descs at: id) ] ] ifFalse: [ d accessor: (decodeAccessor value: (n at: 'accessor')) ].
 (n includesKey: 'reference') ifTrue: [ d reference: (descs at: (n at: 'reference')) ].
 (n includesKey: 'classes') ifTrue: [ d classes: ((n at: 'classes') collect: [ :name | Smalltalk globals at: name asSymbol ]) ].
 (n includesKey: 'options') ifTrue: [ d options: ((n at: 'options') collect: [ :v | decode value: v ]). d propertyAt: #labels put: (IdentityDictionary newFrom: ((n at: 'labels') collect: [ :entry | (decode value: (entry at: 'value')) -> (entry at: 'label') ])) ].
 d conditions: ((n at: 'conditions') collect: [ :c | (decodePredicate value: (c at: 'predicate')) -> (c at: 'label') ]) ].
(input at: 'objects') do: [ :o | | m | m := objects at: (o at: 'id'). (o at: 'values') keysAndValuesDo: [ :id :v | m write: (decode value: v) using: (descs at: id) ] ].
encode := [ :v | | type entries |
 (objectIds includesKey: v) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'reference'. 'value' -> (objectIds at: v) } ] ifFalse: [
 v isNil ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifFalse: [
 (v isKindOf: Boolean) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'boolean'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isInteger ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'integer'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 v isFloat ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'float'. 'value' -> (v asIEEE64BitWord printPaddedWith: $0 to: 16 base: 16) asLowercase } ] ifFalse: [
 v isSymbol ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'symbol'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 v isString ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'string'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isCharacter ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'character'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 type := v class = Array ifTrue: [ 'array' ] ifFalse: [ (v isKindOf: OrderedCollection) ifTrue: [ 'ordered' ] ifFalse: [ (v isKindOf: Set) ifTrue: [ 'set' ] ifFalse: [ (v isKindOf: Bag) ifTrue: [ 'bag' ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported value' ] ] ] ].
 entries := v collect: [ :e | encode value: e ]. Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> type. 'value' -> entries asArray } ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
exportPredicate := [ :p | | n |
 n := Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> p class name asString }.
 p class = MAPluggableCondition ifTrue: [
 n at: 'selector' put: (p instVarNamed: 'selector') asString; at: 'index' put: (p instVarNamed: 'index'); at: 'receiver' put: (encode value: (p instVarNamed: 'receiver')); at: 'arguments' put: ((p instVarNamed: 'arguments') collect: [ :v | encode value: v ]) asArray ] ifFalse: [
 n at: 'conditions' put: ((p class = MANegationCondition ifTrue: [ { p instVarNamed: 'condition' } ] ifFalse: [ p instVarNamed: 'conditions' ]) collect: [ :c | exportPredicate value: c ]) asArray ]. n ].
exportAccessor := [ :a | | n steps next |
 n := Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> a class name asString }.
 a class = MAChainAccessor ifTrue: [
 steps := OrderedCollection new. next := a.
 [ next class = MAChainAccessor ] whileTrue: [ steps add: (exportAccessor value: next accessor). next := next next ].
 steps add: (exportAccessor value: next). n at: 'steps' put: steps asArray ] ifFalse: [
 a class = MASelectorAccessor ifTrue: [ n at: 'readSelector' put: a readSelector asString; at: 'writeSelector' put: (a writeSelector ifNil: [ '' ] ifNotNil: [ :s | s asString ]) ] ifFalse: [
 a class = MAVariableAccessor ifTrue: [ n at: 'name' put: a name asString ] ifFalse: [
 a class = MANullAccessor ifTrue: [ n at: 'uuid' put: (encode value: a uuid) ] ifFalse: [
 (a isKindOf: MADictionaryAccessor) ifTrue: [ n at: 'key' put: a key asString ] ] ] ] ]. n ].
exportNode := [ :id :d | | n props labels |
 props := Dictionary new.
 d properties keysAndValuesDo: [ :k :v |
 (#(conditions labels) includes: k) ifFalse: [
 k = #displayBlockOrSymbol ifTrue: [ v = #greaseString ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported display override' ] ] ifFalse: [ props at: k asString put: (encode value: v) ] ] ].
 d class = MATokenDescription ifTrue: [ props at: 'separators' put: (encode value: d separators) ].
 n := Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> id. 'class' -> d class name asString. 'properties' -> props.
 'conditions' -> (d conditions collect: [ :assoc | Dictionary newFrom: { 'label' -> assoc value. 'predicate' -> (exportPredicate value: assoc key) } ]) asArray }.
 d isContainer ifTrue: [ n at: 'children' put: (d children collect: [ :c | ids at: c ]) asArray ] ifFalse: [ n at: 'accessor' put: (exportAccessor value: d accessor) ].
 (d isKindOf: MAReferenceDescription) ifTrue: [ n at: 'reference' put: (ids at: d reference) ].
 (d isKindOf: MARelationDescription) ifTrue: [ n at: 'classes' put: (d classes collect: [ :c | c name asString ]) asArray ].
 (d isKindOf: MAOptionDescription) ifTrue: [
 n at: 'options' put: (d options collect: [ :v | encode value: v ]) asArray.
 labels := OrderedCollection new.
 (d propertyAt: #labels ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ]) keysAndValuesDo: [ :v :label | labels add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'value' -> (encode value: v). 'label' -> label }) ].
 n at: 'labels' put: labels asArray ]. n ].

model := objects at: 'model'.
self assert: (model readUsing: (descs at: 'score')) = 8.
self assert: (descs at: 'score') min = 7.
self assert: (model readUsing: (descs at: 'name')) = 'Local'.
(descs at: 'editor') validate: model.
exported := Dictionary newFrom: { 'format' -> 'magritte.graph/3'. 'root' -> (input at: 'root').
 'descriptions' -> (descs keys sorted collect: [ :id | exportNode value: id value: (descs at: id) ]) asArray.
 'objects' -> (objects keys sorted collect: [ :id | | m | m := objects at: id.
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> id. 'description' -> (ids at: m magritteDescription). 'values' -> (Dictionary newFrom: (m values associations collect: [ :a | (ids at: a key) -> (encode value: a value) ])) } ]) asArray }.
(path copyReplaceAll: '-native.json' with: '-gt.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: exported) ].
reports add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'source' -> path. 'descriptions' -> descs size. 'objects' -> objects size. 'validated' -> true }) ].
reports asArray
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'editing-roundtrip-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"kind":"pure-magritte-reference","nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base , 'editing-roundtrip-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].
report
